tools.name: kr_sms_length
tools.description: Count message bytes as Korean carriers do (Korean/CJK 2 bytes, ASCII 1) and tell whether it fits SMS (90 bytes) or LMS (2,000 bytes). Flags emoji and other characters that may break in SMS.

tools.name: kr_ad_sms_check
tools.description: Check a Korean marketing text message against the display rules of the Network Act Art. 50 and Enforcement Decree Annex 6, and the night-time (21:00-08:00 KST) separate-consent rule when send_at is given. Returns each check with the legal basis.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "kr-sms" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kr_ad_sms_check · Public sink: kr_sms_length, kr_ad_sms_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kr_ad_sms_check · Public sink: kr_sms_length, kr_ad_sms_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
